title: Scale-Aware 3D Deep Learning for Robust Brain Metastasis Detection in Multimodal MRI
abstract: arXiv:2609.10825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detecting brain metastases in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains challenging because lesions vary widely in size and appearance, with very small metastases occupying only a minute fraction of a three-dimensional input. We investigate whether combining different spatial fields of view (FOVs) improves lesion detection in multimodal MRI and present a scale-aware 3D deep-learning framework. The method uses independently trained $96^3$ and $64^3$ 3D U-Nets whose whole-volume probability maps are combined by weighted late fusion. This design allows us to study the effect of spatial context separately from image resolution and modality choice. On a 97-patient development cohort, cross-FOV fusion improved lesion-level precision and F1 while substantially reducing false positives relative to the individual models. translated_title: 面向多模态MRI脑转移瘤鲁棒检测的尺度感知三维深度学习
translated_abstract: 在磁共振成像（MRI）中检测脑转移瘤仍然具有挑战性，因为病灶在大小和外观上差异很大，非常小的转移瘤仅占三维输入的极小部分。我们研究了结合不同空间视野（FOV）能否改善多模态MRI中的病灶检测，并提出了一种尺度感知的三维深度学习框架。该方法使用独立训练的96³和64³三维U-Net，其全体积概率图通过加权后期融合进行合并。这一设计使我们能够将空间上下文的影响与图像分辨率和模态选择分离开来分别研究。在一个包含97名患者的开发队列中，跨FOV融合相比单个模型提高了病灶级别的精确率和F1分数，同时显著减少了假阳性。相同FOV的集成对照实验表明，这些提升不能仅仅用独立训练网络的平均化效应来解释……
tldr: 该论文提出一种尺度感知的三维深度学习框架，通过加权后期融合独立训练的96³和64³两种视野的3D U-Net全体积概率图，在多模态MRI脑转移瘤检测中显著提升病灶级精确率和F1分数并大幅减少假阳性。
en_tdlr: A scale-aware 3D deep-learning framework that fuses whole-volume probability maps from independently trained 96³ and 64³ 3D U-Nets via weighted late fusion, improving lesion-level precision and F1 while substantially reducing false positives for brain metastasis detection in multimodal MRI.
